baseline_models.reading: Woe is directed at those who give less than is due—those who shortchange in measure.

focus_anchor.role: The focus itself supplies the warning and names its addressees.

baseline_models.mechanism: The warning particle and the plural agent noun establish a direct condemnation of the people characterized by diminution; the focus alone does not require a broader narrative mechanism.
baseline_models.reader_inference: The packet supplies the focus wording but no mapped Furuq target for ط ف ف. The short-measure paraphrase uses ordinary Arabic morphology rather than a packet branch, and no additional causal assumption is needed.
baseline_models.containment: Keep this as the ordinary lexical warning about short measure. Do not infer the later accounting, inward effects, or social analogies from the focus alone.

context_deltas.reading: The woe specifically targets a reciprocal commercial asymmetry: the addressees secure the full amount for themselves while reducing what they hand to others.

focus_anchor.role: The named short-measurers are the focus category made concrete by the paired transaction clauses.

activation_trace.role: The food-measure image grounds the focus in a measured-goods transaction.
The completion-without-shortfall image supports their taking the whole due.
The same measure image now governs what they dispense to the other party.
The balance-and-equity image places the weighing in a fairness and accounting frame.
The shorting-measure image explicitly marks the outgoing deficit.

structural_cues.role: The first conditional clause says that, when taking from people, they take the full amount.
The matched conditional reverses the direction and explicitly says that they make the other side deficient.

context_deltas.mechanism: The mirrored إذا clauses, full-completion image, weighing-for-equity image, and explicit shorting image turn the generic warning into a precise one-way exchange: full entitlement for self and deficiency for the counterpart.

changed_reading.before: A general warning against people who diminish what is due.
changed_reading.after: A warning against the trader who takes the full due from others but gives them less in measure or weight.

context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the measure, completion, balance, and shortfall images and the two opposed clauses. I infer the transactional asymmetry from their direction and syntax. The balance branch can also support a wider justice reading, but the immediate context keeps this model commercial.
context_deltas.containment: Restrict the claim to the explicit measure-and-weight exchange in 83:2-3. Do not treat every mapped meaning of the roots as active, and do not claim that the focus root itself has a supplied branch.

context_deltas.reading: The warning acquires an accountability horizon: the short-measurers are challenged as people who will be raised and stand before the Lord on a great day.

focus_anchor.role: The focus warning is given its final-account setting by the following resurrection sequence.

activation_trace.role: The rousing-from-stillness image supports the passive raising of the addressees.
The event-day image makes the day a decisive, severe occasion.
The greatness image supplies the scale of that day.
The resurrection-and-standing image directly activates the scene of people rising before judgment.
The lordship and authority image identifies the one before whom they stand.

structural_cues.role: The rhetorical question challenges the addressees' anticipation of being raised.
The next phrase names the great day toward which the raising points.
The sequence culminates in people standing before the Lord of the worlds.

context_deltas.mechanism: The passage moves directly from the warning's addressees to being raised and standing before divine authority, supplying the horizon that makes a seemingly ordinary commercial deficit answerable beyond the transaction.

changed_reading.before: The focus warns against short measure as an immediate moral wrong.
changed_reading.after: The warning also confronts short measurers with the great day on which their conduct is answerable before the Lord.

context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the raising, great-day, resurrection-standing, and lordship images, while the text supplies the ordered sequence. I infer the accountability relation from that sequence. Whether يَظُنُّ is heard as expectation, supposition, or certainty remains a live grammatical alternative; the model does not depend on choosing among those nuances.
context_deltas.containment: Claim only the accountability horizon explicitly formed by 83:4-6. Do not infer details of the resurrection scene or use this context as a lexical definition of ط ف ف.

context_deltas.reading: The warning participates in a record-and-character arc: transgression is associated with a marked record and with acquired acts settling over the heart.

focus_anchor.role: The focus category is placed within the later description of recorded and inwardly consequential wrongdoing.

activation_trace.role: The binding-record image gives the book a judgment-bearing force.
The departure-from-right image characterizes the group whose record is being described.
The confinement image limits the record's named setting without requiring a larger cosmological claim.
The writing-and-book image supports a preserved written record.
The marked-writing image makes the record specified and traceable.
The transgression image connects the focus's unfair act with overstepping a right.
The loading-sin image marks the actor as carrying a charge, not merely making an isolated mistake.
The no-escape image gives the heart-covering consequence an entrapping direction.
The inward-heart image locates the consequence in the person's inner faculty.
The acquired-gain image keeps the consequence tied to what the actors themselves have earned or acquired.

structural_cues.role: The text introduces a named record for the transgressing group.
The short nominal sentence characterizes that record as marked or specified.
The passage names the relevant actor as one who transgresses and bears sin.

structural_cues.quote_ar: رَانَ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ
structural_cues.role: The closing clause links the heart-covering condition to what they have been acquiring or doing.

context_deltas.mechanism: The window extends the focus from a single shortfall to a durable pattern: the wrongdoers have a marked record, their transgression carries a charge, and their acquired acts settle over the inward heart.

changed_reading.before: The focus condemns a short measure at the point of exchange.
changed_reading.after: The warning also points to short measure as part of an accumulated, recorded pattern that can harden the actor inwardly.

context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the record, marking, transgression, sin-loading, heart, entrapment, and acquisition images; the text supplies their sequence. I infer that the focus's addressees are being read within this wider fujjar pattern, not that ط ف ف etymologically means record or heart-covering. Sijjin and رَانَ retain broader lexical possibilities, so the model stays at the level of the contextual arc.
context_deltas.containment: Do not claim a specific metaphysical definition of Sijjin, a single mechanism for رَانَ, or that every short measure is individually described by these verses. The supported claim is the window's record-and-inner-consequence framing.

context_deltas.reading: The focus warning is contrasted with a positive counter-ledger: the righteous have an elevated marked record, are witnessed by the near ones, and direct competition toward pure sealed provision.

focus_anchor.role: The focus warning gains a contrasting moral destination from the paired account of the righteous.

activation_trace.role: The written-book image establishes the righteous counterpart to the earlier record.
The broad-righteousness image identifies the positive group.
The rising-and-elevation image supports the high counterpart to the earlier setting.
The repeated book image keeps the two ledgers structurally parallel.
The marked-record image gives the righteous ledger the same determinacy of inscription.
The privileged-nearness image explains who can witness the elevated record.
The pure-choice provision image gives the positive reward a quality of unadulterated value.
The sealing image presents the provision as secured and intact.
The precious-value and rivalry image redirects competition toward what is genuinely valued.

structural_cues.role: The text explicitly introduces the elevated righteous counterpart to the earlier record.
The repeated marked-record wording makes the two sides structurally comparable.
The righteous record is publicly witnessed by those brought near.
The imperative redirects rivalry toward the described provision.

context_deltas.mechanism: The window reverses the low, confined record of the fujjar with an elevated, marked, witnessed record for the abrar, then gives competition a positive object; this supplies a counter-model to the focus's deficit and self-serving exchange.

changed_reading.before: The focus condemns a deficient exchange without specifying a positive alternative.
changed_reading.after: The warning marks a fork between deficient self-serving conduct and an elevated, intact moral ledger whose proper competition is for pure reward.

context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the paired record, righteousness, elevation, nearness, purity, sealing, and rivalry images, and the text supplies the reversal and imperative. I infer that the positive section functions as a counter-ledger for the focus warning; it remains possible to read the reward passage as self-contained description rather than an extension of the focus.
context_deltas.containment: This is a contextual contrast, not a claim that ط ف ف lexically means the opposite of ب ر ر or that the reward images describe commerce. Keep the contrast tied to the parallel records and explicit competition in 83:18-26.

surprising_valid_outliers.reading: As a branch-distant social analogy, the focus's language of making another lesser can echo public belittling: the wrongdoers laugh and gesture at believers, and the scene later reverses with recompense.

focus_anchor.role: The proposed analogy returns to the focus's named agents of diminution rather than treating the social scene as an independent theme.

activation_trace.role: The guilt-and-offense image identifies the laughing actors as wrongdoers.
The mockery image makes the laughter a social act directed at another group.
The same mockery image is reversed onto the disbelievers.
The returning-recompense image supplies the explicit reversal back to the doers.

structural_cues.quote_ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ أَجْرَمُوا۟ كَانُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ يَضْحَكُونَ
structural_cues.role: The text sets wrongdoers' laughter against believers as a relation between groups.
The gesture of mutual winking makes the belittling public and embodied; غ م ز is a packet source gap.

structural_cues.quote_ar: فَٱلْيَوْمَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلْكُفَّارِ يَضْحَكُونَ
structural_cues.role: The temporal pivot reverses who laughs at whom.

structural_cues.quote_ar: هَلْ ثُوِّبَ ٱلْكُفَّارُ مَا كَانُوا۟ يَفْعَلُونَ
structural_cues.role: The closing question frames the reversal as recompense for what they used to do.

surprising_valid_outliers.mechanism: Mockery diminishes another party socially rather than by weight, while the sequence's laughter reversal and recompense create a relational mirror; that mirror is analogous to taking full value for oneself and reducing the other's share.

changed_reading.before: The focus refers to material short measure.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it can echo a wider practice of making others lesser through ridicule, with status and laughter returned in judgment.

surprising_valid_outliers.reader_inference: The packet supplies the mockery branch for ض ح ك and the returning-recompense branch for ث و ب; the structural text supplies the gestures and reversal. I infer the analogy from relational diminishment, not from a lexical identity between ط ف ف and mockery. The focus root and غ م ز both lack mapped branches, and the live alternative is that 83:29-36 concerns only social ridicule within its own subject.
surprising_valid_outliers.containment: Keep this exploratory and explicitly analogical. Downstream prose must not define mutaffifin as mockers; it may say only that the later social reversal echoes the focus's diminishment relation.

summary.ordinary_reading: The focus gives a direct warning of woe to those who shortchange others, ordinarily in measure.
coexisting_readings: 83:2-3 specifies the warning as a one-way commercial asymmetry: full measure when taking, short measure when giving.
83:4-6 places that conduct under resurrection accountability before the Lord.
83:7-14 presents wrongdoing as a marked record and as acquired acts settling over the heart.
83:18-26 supplies an elevated, witnessed counter-ledger for the righteous and redirects competition toward intact, pure reward.
Exploratory only: 83:29-36 supports a branch-distant analogy to social belittling and its reversed recompense.
unresolved_limits: The packet lists no mapped Furuq targets for the focus root ط ف ف, so the baseline and every return to the focus anchor must remain grounded in the focus wording and ordinary morphology.
The root غ م ز in the social scene also has no mapped branch; that outlier relies on its exact structural text plus the available ض ح ك and ث و ب branches.

The readings do not settle the full lexical or metaphysical range of Sijjin, رَانَ, the resurrection scene, or the reward imagery; the exploratory social analogy must not be promoted to a lexical definition.
